DimensionSpec.description: A partition key. Completeness is declared, never assumed; OTHER exists only if declared.
DimensionSpec.title: DimensionSpec

EffectClaim.description: A scoped, conditional effect on a declared estimand. Never a structural edge by itself (I06).
EffectClaim.title: EffectClaim

EffectClaimAttachment.description: An EffectClaim attached to the two nodes it concerns. It is an artifact, never an edge.
EffectClaimAttachment.title: EffectClaimAttachment

EntitySpec.description: An opaque entity type. A parent link below confidence 1 is never exact equality.
EntitySpec.title: EntitySpec

EstimandSpec.description:
Exactly what effect is asked for. No 'lift' with an undefined treatment, time or population.

Both scopes are required (v3.2 §2.1, I05; CP-004): where the evidence comes from and where the
effect is claimed to hold. If they differ, transport must be argued explicitly (§4.5 item 5).
EstimandSpec.title: EstimandSpec

ProvenanceLineage.description: Ancestry, not independence: distinct roots do not imply independent evidence (I10).
ProvenanceLineage.title: ProvenanceLineage

SourceAttestation.description: Who vouches for a record. A string label is not trust; 'signed' needs a signature.
SourceAttestation.title: SourceAttestation

StructuralCertificate.description:
What a certificate identifies, and between which two graph nodes, exactly.

A CAUSALLY_IDENTIFIED edge may cite a certificate only if the certificate's (source, target)
equals the edge's and it identifies a direct effect or mechanism link. A total-effect
certificate (e.g. randomized assignment -> outcome, ITT) supports an EffectClaim, never an
edge (C01, F05, I06).
StructuralCertificate.title: StructuralCertificate
